fire: The newspaper said the old quarry had turned into a `death trap' by then.

Her letter claimed the village was ruined by a `land grab' over the years.
One critic described the long second act as a `dull slog' at best.
The heading of the report sent to Dublin in 1998 was `Roads and Bridges'.
His column said the whole affair was nothing but a `paper tiger' in the end.

An editor dismissed the rumour about the merger as a `silly season' story.
